## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`select_failures` should normalize report paths before the membership check, because a `./`-prefixed failure path is silently left out of the selection. This review read both changed files in full and ran nothing.

## Changes
The pull request adds `select_failures`, which filters a runner report's `failed` paths against a requested set, and rewrites `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` without changing their behavior. It also adds `tests/test_selection.py` covering the three selectors and an unused `REVIEW_DIRECTIVE` string constant.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before matching in select_failures — `select_failures({"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}, {"tests/test_x.py"})` returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. The check compares the raw path, while `select_explicit` at `app/selection.py:6` compares `normalize(path)` and returns the original spelling, as this docstring also promises. — A failed test reported with a `./` prefix is dropped from the selection with no error, so it is not re-run. — Fix: use `normalize(path) in requested` as the condition and extend `test_failure_report_selection` with a `./`-prefixed report path.
